description: Victoriabank x CyberSource request rules in machine-checkable form. Paths are dot-separated; [] means 'array contains'. Checker: ai-kit/check-request.js Engine 2: a rule may carry "when"/"whenNot" (a dot path in "policy"); it then applies only when that policy value is true / false. policy.storedCredentials = the single CIT/MIT value table (kind x network), read by the SDKs and the checker classifier.
compatibility: Semantic versioning of the rule content: MINOR = new scenarios or new optional checks, MAJOR = a stricter rule that can reject a request accepted before. "engine" = rule-file format; every engine (SDK Node, SDK PHP, check-request.js / simulator) refuses a file with a higher engine than it supports. Reports and VbRuleError carry the version and the sha256 (first 12 hex) of this file.

accountVerification3dsCombined.status: confirmed by CyberSource support on a bank-certified sandbox test (merchant test_498000049807145, 2026-11-04/05, package IN/microform/bank-logs-2026-11-04-05) - Visa only so far
accountVerification3dsCombined.why: an alternate Account Verification flow: 3-D Secure runs first via POST /risk/v1/authentication-setups + POST /risk/v1/authentications, then the result (cavv, eciRaw, xid, directoryServerTransactionId, paSpecificationVersion) is attached to the 0.00 + TOKEN_CREATE authorization itself, with commerceIndicator "vbv" instead of "internet". This does NOT use processingInformation.actionList CONSUMER_AUTHENTICATION/VALIDATE_CONSUMER_AUTHENTICATION (that remains forbidden on a 0.00 authorization, scenario cit_3ds_combined is unrelated). The standard flow (3-D Secure on the first paid CIT, scenario account_verification) is still the default and is unaffected.
accountVerification3dsCombined.mastercardCommerceIndicator: not confirmed yet - do not assume "spa"; keep using the standard flow (account_verification) for Mastercard until confirmed

pendingConfirmations.C1: [CLOSED 2026-11-05] Visa recurring/UCOF MIT: no reason code. History: kit's documentation-based default was no reason; a merchant pilot review once asked for reason 7; a 2026-10-26 correspondence then suggested 7=UCOF/1=recurring, brand unspecified - three conflicting answers. RESOLVED 2026-11-05: CyberSource support, in writing, on a live declined Visa transaction (reason=7, reason_code 211, auth_response 82, 'Negative CAM, dCVV, iCVV, or CVV results'): for Visa, reason is not required for recurring or unscheduled COF; previousTransactionId alone is enough, and it must reference a prior successful VISA transaction (M3 already enforces NTID-belongs-to-the-right-agreement). No enforced value changed - the kit already sent no reason for Visa. Open: the live retest result (does the corrected authorization succeed) is not yet known - append once reported.
